name: Rustic Botanical
description: An organic, garden-grown look built around exposed cake layers, fresh greenery, and a deliberately imperfect hand-finished texture.
paletteGuidance: Sage, dusty terracotta, cream, and muted wildflower tones — avoid anything glossy or high-shine.
textureGuidance: A thin 'semi-naked' scrape of buttercream that lets the sponge layers show through, finished with fresh or sugar-crafted greenery, berries, and seasonal blooms tucked between tiers.

name: Modern Minimalist
description: Clean geometric lines, a restrained palette, and precise sculpted surfaces — the cake reads as architecture first, dessert second.
paletteGuidance: Monochrome white, soft greige, or a single bold accent color against a matte white base — no more than two colors total.
textureGuidance: Smooth, mirror-flat fondant panels with sharp tier edges; any decoration is a single deliberate accent (one botanical stem, one metallic line) rather than an all-over pattern.

name: Traditional Luxury
description: The timeless formal wedding cake — tiered, symmetrical, and finished with classic piped detail meant to photograph as a grand centerpiece.
paletteGuidance: Ivory, white, and gold, with soft blush or champagne accents.
textureGuidance: Smooth buttercream or fondant with raised piped lace, beading, or basketweave detail; fresh flowers cascading down one side.

name: Cultural Heritage Ornate
description: A richly decorated, multi-generational centerpiece built to carry the visual weight and symbolism of a specific cultural tradition.
paletteGuidance: Bold, saturated tones drawn from the couple's heritage — deep reds and golds, vivid jewel tones, or hand-painted motifs rather than a muted palette.
textureGuidance: Elaborate piped or hand-painted detail, gold leaf, and pronounced ornamentation on every visible tier surface.

name: Boho Garden
description: Airy, undressed, and floral-forward — feels like it was cut fresh from a wildflower field rather than a bakery kitchen.
paletteGuidance: Warm neutrals, dried-flower rust and mauve tones, with pops of golden yellow.
textureGuidance: Very light frosting coverage, visible crumb, dried and fresh florals, pampas grass, and edible foraged-looking accents.

name: Glam Art Deco
description: Geometric, metallic, and unapologetically dramatic — sharp fondant panels with repeating deco patterning.
paletteGuidance: Black, gold, and ivory, or deep emerald and gold for a bolder statement.
textureGuidance: Fondant panel work with hand-painted or piped fan and chevron motifs, metallic leafing along every tier edge.

name: Whimsical Pastel Piping
description: Playful, hand-piped buttercream detail — lambeth-style borders, dots, and swirls in a soft color story.
paletteGuidance: Pastel pink, lilac, mint, and butter yellow, often combined across a single cake.
textureGuidance: A smooth buttercream base as the canvas for dense piped borders, rosettes, and dot-work — needs a stable sponge underneath to hold the piping's weight.

name: Coastal Destination
description: Light, breezy, and built for warm-weather celebrations — reads as effortless even when it isn't.
paletteGuidance: Sandy neutrals, seafoam, and white, with dried palm or citrus accents.
textureGuidance: Light semi-naked or lightly frosted finish that avoids heat-fragile fondant, dressed with dried citrus slices, palm fronds, or delicate sugar shells.
